title: [GMCP 203.043.M] Mastery: Cross-platform packaging, service integration, and distribution
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-043-M. Pass the complete vector mastery target on the shipped production path: Identical supported GMCP capability is packaged for Linux, macOS and Windows across x86_64 and arm64 with signed, reproducible artifacts, service-manager integration, upgrade/rollback, uninstall, path/permission handling and diagnostics. A declared parity matrix has automated clean-machine, non-admin, Unicode-path, sleep/resume and upgrade tests; unavoidable platform differences are explicit and policy-safe. Consume and verify the evidence produced by requirements 01-06; reject missing, stale, unsigned, locally modified, waived, mock-only, or zero-test evidence. Task closure and roadmap prose are not proof.
